name: Infoblox — RPZ NXDOMAIN Block (First C2 Domain Blocked at DNS)
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "Threat"
| filter infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log contains "RPZ-QNAME"
| alter src_ip = arrayindex(regextract(infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log, "src=(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"), 0),
        blocked_domain = arrayindex(regextract(infoblox_infoblox_raw._raw_log, "rewrite (\S+) \["), 0)
| filter src_ip != null
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count() as rpz_nxd,
       count_distinct(blocked_domain) as distinct_domains,
       values(blocked_domain) as blocked_domains
       by src_ip, _time
| filter rpz_nxd >= 1
| fields src_ip, blocked_domains
description: Infoblox xdm.event.type = 'Threat' with RPZ-QNAME and NXDOMAIN markers — C2 domain matched RPZ threat intel and was returned NXDOMAIN.
alert_name: Infoblox — RPZ NXDOMAIN Block (First C2 Domain Blocked at DNS)
alert_description:
What fired: Infoblox xdm.event.type = 'Threat' with RPZ-QNAME and NXDOMAIN markers — C2 domain matched RPZ threat intel and was returned NXDOMAIN.

Why it matters: a host is communicating with known-bad or anomalous infrastructure (C2 / malicious domain). Assessed severity: High.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1071.004 - Application Layer Protocol: DNS (TA0011 - Command and Control).

Investigate:
  - Identify the internal client and the domain/IP contacted, and check reputation + resolution history.
  - Look for the initial delivery vector (email/web/download) and any beaconing cadence or follow-on payloads from the same host.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (src_ip) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
